status: mechanism evidence only; no numerical/production correction implemented
diagnostic_depth_scope: 257 native manifold samples per path; not a continuous-time physical bound
mechanism: gap() is a conservative lower-clearance proxy using whole-interval worst-case rotational extents. Its hi is not an upper enclosure of the actual gap. certify() nevertheless prunes on hi<=0, preventing any tightening subdivision in all78 records despite a strictly positive endpoint clearance bound.
proposed_correction_boundary: Remove nonpositive-upper-proxy subdivision pruning while retaining existing maximum depth3, original5mm slop, native trajectory, contact predicate and solver settings. Validate independently before adoption.
